captions: 3:41 p.m. Lane four. The card machine beeps twice.
“Declined.” The man behind you sighs. Your face burns.
Outside, you text your brother. Your friend. No reply.
Then your phone lights up: “Asr ends in 14 minutes.”
At the bus stop, you pray Asr. Your bag at your feet.
Then you tell Him. Not just the $47.90. The fear beneath it.
The bus pulls in. Nothing's fixed yet. But you're not alone.

post.caption:
Card declined at $47.90. You asked everyone but Allah. 🤍

The panic says: fix it now, alone. The prayer says: you were never alone.

“So do not weaken and do not grieve.” (3:139)

Before Maghrib today: pray Asr. Then tell Him your worry.
